verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product with extensive public documentation of its API surface. That covers Search, Contents, Answer, the Agent API and the Websets API, plus an endpoint reference with response schemas, rate-limit docs, downloadable OpenAPI specs, official SDKs (exa-py/exa-js) and llms.txt/markdown docs for agents. A hands-on user independently reported being impressed with the search API in an agentic chatbot integration. Missing for 10: the OpenAPI spec is not served at standard discoverable paths (the probe returned 404s), and one user reported a dashboard 'Get Code' cURL snippet with incorrect escaping.
